use anyhow::{ensure,Result};
use erc20_balances_storage_tools::{data::*,rpc::*,inspect::storage_reads,trace_context};
use serde_json::{json,Value};
use primitive_types::U256;
use std::{fs,path::Path};
fn main()->Result<()> {
let root=Path::new("erc20/balances-storage");let out=root.join("out/next450-mismatch-compact");fs::create_dir(&out)?;
let source=root.join("out/ranks401-450-survey/rpc-checks.jsonl");let rows=fs::read_to_string(&source)?.lines().map(serde_json::from_str::<Value>).collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>,_>>()?.into_iter().filter(|r|r["match"]==false).collect::<Vec<_>>();ensure!(rows.len()==7,"expected seven value mismatches");let rpc=HttpRpc::from_env();let mut result=vec![];
for(i,row)in rows.iter().enumerate(){let out_case=out.join(format!("case{}",i+1));fs::create_dir(&out_case)?;let contract=text(&row["contract"])?;let address=text(&row["address"])?;let height=number(&row["block"])?-u64::from(row["boundary"]=="before");let header=rpc.header(height)?;ensure!(header["hash"]==row["hash"],"fork");let at=block_ref(text(&header["hash"])?);let key=text(&row["storage_key"])?;let balance=rpc.balance(contract,address,at.clone())?;let stored=quantity(&rpc.call("eth_getStorageAt",json!([contract,key,at]))?)?;ensure!(balance.to_string()==row["rpc"]&&stored.to_string()==row["storage"],"original failure changed");let code=rpc.call("eth_getCode",json!([contract,at]))?;let bytes=hex::decode(text(&code)?.trim_start_matches("0x"))?;fs::write(out_case.join("runtime.hex"),text(&code)?)?;
let (_,params)=balance_request(contract,address,at.clone());let call=&params[0];let trace_response=rpc.request(json!({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"debug_traceCall","params":[call,at,{"enableMemory":false,"disableStack":false,"disableStorage":true,"enableReturnData":false,"timeout":"10s"}]}))?;fs::write(out_case.join("trace-response.json"),serde_json::to_vec(&trace_response)?)?;ensure!(trace_response["error"].is_null(),"trace RPC error: {}",trace_response["error"]);let trace=trace_response["result"].clone();fs::write(out_case.join("trace.json"),serde_json::to_vec(&trace)?)?;ensure!(trace["failed"]==false,"trace failed");let contexts=trace_context::inspect(&trace,contract)?;let code_binding=trace_context::validate_code(&rpc,&at,&contexts)?;
let mut path=vec![];for step in items(&trace,"structLogs")? {if step["depth"]!=1 {continue;}let pc=number(&step["pc"])? as usize;let width=if (0x60..=0x7f).contains(&bytes[pc]){usize::from(bytes[pc]-0x5f)}else{0};let op=text(&step["op"])?;let mut line=format!("{pc}: {op} {}",hex::encode(&bytes[pc+1..pc+1+width]));if ["JUMP","JUMPI","SLOAD","SSTORE","TIMESTAMP","NUMBER","DIV","MUL","ADD","SUB","EXP","LT","GT"].contains(&op){let s=items(step,"stack")?;line.push_str(&format!(" stack_tail={}",json!(&s[s.len().saturating_sub(3)..])));}path.push(line);}fs::write(out_case.join("path.txt"),path.join("\n"))?;
let mut controls=vec![];for v in [U256::zero(),U256::one(),U256::from(123),U256::MAX] {let diff=json!({key:format!("0x{v:064x}")});let response=rpc.request(json!({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[call,at,{contract:{"stateDiff":diff}}]}))?;controls.push(json!({"state_diff":diff,"raw":v.to_string(),"response":response}));}
let evidence=json!({"case":i+1,"original":row,"height":height,"hash":header["hash"],"timestamp":header["timestamp"],"storage_word":stored.to_string(),"balance_of":balance.to_string(),"runtime_hash":format!("0x{}",hex::encode(erc20_balances_storage::hash(&bytes))),"runtime_bytes":bytes.len(),"storage_reads":storage_reads(&trace)?,"contexts":contexts,"execution_code":code_binding,"trace_sha256":sha256(&out_case.join("trace.json"))?,"path_file":format!("case{}/path.txt",i+1),"raw_controls":controls});result.push(evidence);fs::write(out.join("report.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"status":"inspecting","source_sha256":sha256(&source)?,"cases":result}))?)?;ensure!(rpc.header(height)?["hash"]==header["hash"],"header changed");println!("Inspected mismatch case{}",i+1);
}
fs::write(out.join("report.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"status":"inspected","source_sha256":sha256(&source)?,"cases":result,"scope":"Read-only diagnosis preserving all seven original RPC value discrepancies, no promotion."}))?)?;Ok(())}
